retry_policy.provider: Muse built-in image and image-to-video tools; signed-in Chrome px75 account
retry_policy.transient_retry: Poll/download any unresolved job; do not resubmit. A confirmed terminal generation failure or saved visual QA rejection may use the bounded retry policy. Retrieval-only retries do not spend generation calls.
retry_policy.global_blocker: Stop submitting new media calls, persist and publish partial output, mark remaining work blocked, and report the exact service error. No unsolicited recurring schedule.
retry_policy.repair_rule: At most one extra call per rejected/terminally failed stage, shared production budget of 12 extra calls. Prepare retry explicitly with checkpoint.py retry. Never recreate approved images or videos; preserve rejected files with versioned replacement paths.
retry_policy.message_limit: A per-message tool/image cap is a turn boundary, not a permanent scene/account failure. Save the current job and checkpoint, package partial output and state the exact next work unit. Never mark untouched scenes blocked for a per-message cap.

cross_message_continuation: The JSON/helper reports state only. It cannot self-send a new Muse message or bypass a per-message cap. A real continuation/task/dispatcher must initiate the next message.
resume_order: Unresolved existing job first; then first-pass pending scenes; then bounded repairs.
authoritative_state: Existing outputs/Bxxx/progress.json and actual asset hashes. Seed/static work units never override live state.
